speaker: penny
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: This is for you.

speaker: penny
text: Ice cream?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I've been familiarizing myself with female emotional crises by studying the comic strip Cathy. When she's upset, she says Ach and eats ice cream.

speaker: penny
text: Um, Ach.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: If you were a cat, I would have brought you a lasagna.

speaker: penny
text: Did Leonard send you over here?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, we haven't spoken since your abrupt departure last night caused us to forfeit to Stuart and his dastardly ringer Wil Wheaton.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, I'm sorry about that.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm not too proud to admit that I cried myself to sleep.

speaker: penny
text: Again, I'm sorry.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And let me tell you sleep did not come easily with Leonard in the next room singing along with Alanis Morrisette.

speaker: penny
text: You're kidding.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No. Clearly another woman in dire need of ice cream.

speaker: penny
text: All right, Sheldon, what part of this is supposed to make me feel better?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The part where I tell you I've engineered a rematch with Stuart's team for tonight.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, honey, I don't know. Things are a little weird with Leonard right now.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You want me to remove him from the team? I'm the captain, I can do that.

speaker: penny
text: No, no, that's okay. Just let me talk to him, and I'll get back to you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: When are you going to talk to him?

speaker: penny
text: I don't know.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: He's in the laundry room now. Now would be a good time.

speaker: penny
text: You're not gonna leave me alone until I do it, are you?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, I think we both know the answer to that question.
